Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. title: Strategy and Planning Expert
description:
What You'll Do

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytical Strategy & Planning Expert to join our team and lead the business evolution of our Innovation vertical. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the business model, managing the end-to-end P&L, and serving as the Project Management Office (PMO) for key implementation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of strategic vision, financial acumen, and operational process design skills to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

  • Business Model Evolution: Design and continuously evolve the business model for the Innovation vertical, including market entry strategies, new service offerings, and go-to-market approaches.
  • P&L Management: Own and manage the P&L for the vertical, including financial forecasting, budget planning, and variance analysis. Identify and execute initiatives to improve profitability and top-line growth.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and lead the strategic planning process for the vertical, identifying market trends, competitive threats, and growth opportunities. Translate strategy into actionable, measurable plans.
  • PMO for Implementation: Serve as the Project Management Office for all strategic initiatives and key implementation projects within the vertical. Define project scope, manage timelines, track progress, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Process Design & Improvement: Design, map, and implement new business processes to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and performance. Conduct root cause analysis to identify process bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Product, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure alignment on strategy and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management: Communicate project updates, financial performance, and strategic direction to key stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Performance Analysis: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business model health, project success, and operational effectiveness.

What We Need From You

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly desirable.
  • Experience: Proven experience in a strategy, planning, business development, or management consulting role, with significant experience in P&L management and process design. Experience in the Food Delivery sector is a plus.
  • Strategic Acumen: Strong ability to think strategically, analyze complex business problems, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical Skills: Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong financial modeling and forecasting skills.
  • Project Management: Expertise in project management methodologies and tools, with experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Process Design: Experience in mapping, designing, and optimizing business processes.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Leadership: A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive change in a fast-paced environment.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Cloud Pleno
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista de Infraestrutura Cloud Pleno sua missão é garantir que a aplicação tenha condições de ser executada adequadamente no ambiente do cliente. Você será protagonista no diagnóstico e apoio na resolução de problemas de desempenho de nossas aplicações no ambiente do cliente. Você precisa ser capaz de avaliar o dimensionamento da infraestrutura do cliente para o cenário atual e orientá-la para as demandas de curto e médio prazo do cliente. Esse trabalho é feito de forma colaborativa com o cliente, responsáveis pela infraestrutura (hardware, rede, SO e DB) dele, consultores das unidades, SD (Service Desk) e DTI (Diretoria de Tecnologia) da Sankhya.

Aqui na Sankhya, acreditamos que crescimento e resultado andam juntos com parceria e propósito. Se você é movido por desafios, gosta de atuar de forma próxima aos clientes e quer construir uma carreira em um ecossistema de inovação, vem com a gente!

title: Solution Engineer
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.

We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Solution Engineer to join our São Paulo office.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Network Planning and Deployment:

- Participate in the planning, design, implementation, and optimization of the company's network architecture, ensuring stability, security, and scalability.

- Responsible for the deployment and configuration of data center environments, corporate networks, and cloud networks (public/private).

- Responsible for assessing network requirements, designing solutions, and implementing new business systems.

2. Daily Operations and Monitoring:

- Responsible for daily monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and incident response across the company's entire network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPNs, wireless networks, etc.).

- Develop and execute network change processes, ensuring standardized operations with controlled risks.

- Prepare operational documentation, technical proposals, and incident reports.

3. Performance and Security Management:

- Continuously monitor network performance, analyze traffic data, and perform capacity planning and performance tuning.

- Responsible for configuring and managing network security policies, including firewall rules, access control lists (ACLs), intrusion detection/prevention, etc.

- Collaborate with the security team on network audits, vulnerability scans, and hardening activities.

4. Technical Support and Collaboration:

- Provide network-level technical support to other internal teams (e.g., systems, application development, business departments).

- Communicate and coordinate with vendors and service providers to resolve issues related to circuits and equipment.

Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or related fields.

- Fluent English.

- Proficiency in the TCP/IP protocol stack, in-depth understanding of the OSI model, and routing and switching principles (e.g., STP, OSPF, BGP, VRRP).

- Proven ability to configure, manage, and troubleshoot network equipment from leading vendors (e.g., Cisco, Huawei, H3C, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet).

Specific Technologies (Knowledge in):

- Security: Knowledge of firewalls, VPNs (IPSec/SSL), WAF, and security policies.

- Wireless: Knowledge of corporate wireless network planning (e.g., Aruba, Cisco) and troubleshooting.- Load Balancing: Knowledge of configuring devices such as F5, Citrix NetScaler, and Nginx.

- Data Center: Knowledge of architectures such as VXLAN, EVPN, and Spine-Leaf.

Automation and Operations Capabilities:

- Familiarity with network monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios).

- Basic programming/scripting skills (e.g., Python, Ansible) for configuration automation, batch operations, and tool development are a plus.

- Knowledge of version control tools such as Git.

Preferred Requirements:

- Certifications: CCNA / HCIA /CCNP / HCIP / CCIE (RS/Security)

- Advanced Chinese (Mandarin) proficiency

Work Model:

This is an on-site position based in São Paulo, with the possibility of occasional business travel.

title: Analista de Confiabilidade Analítica
description:
Sobre nós:

Sobre nós

Há mais de 100 anos, uma paixão única nos move: transformar o mundo por meio da ciência e da inovação. Do Japão à América Latina, cultivamos raízes profundas e, em 2025, celebramos 50 anos de história no Brasil!

Somos uma empresa de pesquisa e desenvolvimento que atua no agronegócio global, oferecendo soluções sustentáveis e inovadoras para a produção de alimentos e a saúde da sociedade. Nossa jornada começou no século XVII, em Quioto, no Japão, e evoluiu para um compromisso global com o bem-estar das pessoas e a preservação do meio ambiente.

Sustentabilidade está no nosso DNA! Aqui, valorizamos a colaboração, a ética e a inovação, sempre impulsionados pelo desejo de deixar um legado positivo para as futuras gerações.

Nosso propósito nos une, e a paixão pelo que fazemos nos impulsiona!

Se você quer fazer parte de um time que transforma desafios em oportunidades e impacto em realidade, vem ser SCLA!

Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar o Plano de desenvolvimento e validação de métodos analíticos.
  • Representante do setor para novos métodos, técnicas analíticas, melhorias e demais projetos.
  • Suportar a liderança na validação e implementação dos recursos em TTMs e NPIs.

  • Focal point para métodos e tecnologia de LC-MS em análises de Contaminação Cruzada.
  • Avaliação de dados e tendências, elaboração de relatórios de análises de Contaminação Cruzada e Microbiológica.
  • Preparação de protocolos de estudos de Análises de Controle de Qualidade, validações de métodos, investigações, entre outros relacionados às atividades.
  • Realizar o Plano de Implementação de modelos de NIR.
  • Realizar a investigação de resultados fora de especificação ou anômalos (OOS), assim como o plano de ação para evitar recorrências.
  • Revisar as tendências de resultados de controle de qualidade com foco em melhorias e ajustes.

Principais Requisitos:

  • Graduação concluída em Química, Química Industrial, Engenharia Química, Farmácia ou afins.
  • Desejável mestrado ou especialização em Química Analítica.
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento e validação de métodos analíticos em indústria química, de alimentos ou farmacêutica.
  • Boas Práticas de Laboratório.
  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento e validação de métodos analíticos avançado.
  • Metodologia de Investigação de Resultados fora de especificação (OOS - Out-of-specification).
  • Conhecimento avançado em manutenção e resolução de problemas em sistemas de cromatografia líquida/gasosa.
  • Conhecimento avançado de HPLC (Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência).

  • Conhecimento avançado de Análise estatística de dados.

title: MCA IV&V Engineer
description:
Descrição do emprego

Essa posição é para atuar em regime presencial, em Contagem, Minas Gerais.

Who will you be working with?

You will be part of Modular Control Architecture (MCA) software team. The MCA SW architecture is highly flexible, made up of many modular software, application, and hardware elements. While flexibility adds opportunity and capability, it also adds complexity, driving the importance of a robust platform SW and communication strategy. MCA is built on MBSE (Model Based System Engineering) principles for requirements management and test cases with full traceability built into the MBSE model.

How will you make a difference?

The "MCA Controls Test Engineer" is responsible for development and maintenance of test plans and procedures to execute the testing on HITL & locomotive environments. This role includes reviewing and analysis of design requirements, functional specifications and creating test plans and test procedures.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical or Instrumentation engineering with a broad technical understanding of IV&V activities.
  • Strong knowledge of related design/test engineering experience with hands on experience on testing and validation utilizing the following platforms: HITL, SITL, system level (preferable Locomotive or Automotive).
  • Experience in developing test procedures for control software, electrical and electronic equipment, systems, and components.
  • Strong understanding of general control design principles including various communication protocols (Serial RS232/422, CAN or ethernet).
  • Ability to work "hands-on" in test labs and on locomotives.
  • Ability to travel (domestic and overseas) as required (travel

What will your typical day look like?

  • Participate in design/system requirements review, specification reviews at various levels within the system/sub-system.
  • Development of test procedure on Magic Draw/Doors to perform system integration testing and system level testing.
  • Provide inputs for creating test environment/setup, review & maintain test results.
  • Execution of test procedures on control software and components utilizing the following platforms: Hardware in the loop (HITL), Model in the loop (MITL), Locomotive.
  • Create a record of all deviations/defects with enough details using formal software life cycle management tools (Clear Quest etc.) & provide support until resolution.
  • Develop automation scripts to automate test procedures, data collection, generate reports and ensure repeatable measurements with the help of test tools and simulators.
  • Perform system-level testing on HITL/Locomotive against the system requirement and interface specification prior to production release.
  • Working closely with the internal and external design/test teams in identifying problems & implementing solutions.
  • Produce periodic status and operational reports
  • Apply and improve the utilization of all software and hardware tools and assist in the creation of new testing software, hardware tools and techniques.
  • Make independent technical contributions in support of program objectives, as well as interacting with other Wabtec or contract engineers.

Benefícios:

Na Wabtec, pessoas estão em primeiro lugar. Por isso, cuidamos para que nossos funcionários se sintam valorizados e tenham as ferramentas necessárias para prosperar. Ao se juntar a nós, você terá acesso a uma série de benefícios pensados para promover seu bem-estar e desenvolvimento. Confira o que oferecemos para que você se sinta parte de uma empresa que apoia sua jornada profissional e pessoal:

  • Assistência Médica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos)
  • Assistência Odontológica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos)
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Política de Alimentação de acordo com localidade
  • Seguro de vida
  • Programa de Assistência ao Empregado: orientação psicológica, jurídica, financeira e assistência social
  • Headspace – aplicativo focado em saúde mental
  • Cartão ou Cesta de Natal aos funcionários de acordo com localidade
  • Presente de Natal para filhos de até 11 anos de idade
  • Licença maternidade estendida
  • Programa para Gestantes e Bebês
  • Política de incentivo a idiomas
  • Programas de Mentoria e acesso a plataforma de treinamento
  • Wellhub
  • Auxílio farmácia

Informações Adicionais

O que você poderia conquistar em um ambiente que realmente coloca as Pessoas em Primeiro Lugar?

Na Wabtec, não se trata apenas de um emprego — é sobre o impacto que você gera. Quando nossas pessoas se unem, Expandimos o Possível,melhorando constantemente o que fazemos e como fazemos — para nossos clientes e para uns aos outros.

Se você está pronto para revolucionar a forma como o mundo se move para as próximas gerações, a Wabtec é o lugar certo para você.

Quem somos nós?

A Wabtec é uma fornecedora global líder em equipamentos, sistemas, soluções digitais e serviços de valor agregado para os setores ferroviários de carga e transporte. Com mais de 150 anos de experiência, estamos na vanguarda em segurança, eficiência, confiabilidade, inovação e produtividade. Seja em carga, transporte, portos, logística, mineração, indústria ou setor marítimo, nossa expertise, nossas tecnologias e nossas pessoas — juntas — estão acelerando o futuro do transporte. Com raízes que remontam a George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison e Louis Faiveley, a Wabtec sempre desenvolveu tecnologias e implementou soluções para diversos setores essenciais, atendendo às necessidades de clientes e governos.

Com cerca de 30.000 colaboradores ao redor do mundo, entregamos desempenho que move o mundo adiante. Somos aprendizes contínuos, apaixonados em evoluir cada vez mais. Saiba mais em

A cultura nos impulsiona e abre possibilidades.

Acreditamos que as melhores ideias surgem da combinação de experiências e origens diversas. Na Wabtec, trabalhamos todos os dias para criar um ambiente onde todos se sintam incluídos. Estamos construindo uma cultura em que a liderança, a inclusão e a sua perspectiva única impulsionam o progresso.

title: SAP AMS Project Manager

The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP AMS Project Manager, Remote mode in Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The SAP AMS Project Manager is responsible for managing the delivery of SAP Application Management Services across multiple modules and business areas. This role oversees incident, problem, change, and enhancement management, ensuring compliance with SLAs, high-quality service delivery, and alignment with business objectives. The SAP AMS Project Manager also drives continuous improvement, governance, and customer satisfaction in a global delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

Service & Project Delivery

Manage day-to-day SAP AMS operations, including incident, problem, change, and service request management.

Oversee delivery of SAP enhancements, small projects, and rollouts within agreed timelines and budgets.

Ensure SLAs, KPIs, and service quality targets are consistently achieved.

Coordinate with SAP Basis, Functional, and Technical teams to resolve issues and deliver solutions.

Drive root cause analysis and preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary contact for clients regarding SAP AMS delivery.

Facilitate regular status, governance, and steering committee meetings.

Build and maintain strong business stakeholder relationships across Finance, Supply Chain, and other SAP domains.

Translate business priorities into SAP AMS delivery plans.

Team & Vendor Coordination

Manage onshore/offshore AMS delivery teams across SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.).

Allocate resources and track performance of functional and technical consultants.

Collaborate with third-party vendors for specialized SAP services (e.g., Cloud, S/4HANA, integrations).

title: Analyst - Documentation
description:
Job Title: Analyst – Documentation

Department: Customer Service & Documentation

Reporting To: Manager – Customer Service and Documentation

Direct Reports: N/A

Job Purpose

The Documentation Analyst is responsible for the efficient handling import/export documentation, ensuring compliance with Brazilian Federal Revenue (RFB) regulations, supporting customers with document requirements, maintaining system integrity, and coordinating with ports, terminals, carriers, and stakeholders. The role ensures timely submissions, documentation accuracy, and professional interactions to support seamless cargo handling.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities

Customer Service & Documentation Handling

• Ensure shipping documentation accuracy including BL issuance, corrections, and approvals

• Respond to customer requests regarding BL, arrival, clearance, cargo information, and deadlines

• Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.g., LOIs, letters, payments)

• Maintain communication with vessels, carriers, terminals, and agents

Regulatory Compliance & System Processing

• Update Carrier systems and internal agency systems

• Ensure BL updates, approvals, and registry details follow Carrier process and Brazilian Regulations as per RFB IN 800 deadlines

• Maintain correct data in Siscomex Carga, safeguarding the interest of the agency and carriers

• Support customers in submitting required guarantees (e.g., LOIs, letters, payments)

• Assist with process of cargo authorization and release document validation

Confidentiality & Compliance

• Ensure confidentiality of customer and company data

• Follow code of ethics, compliance, and data protection protocols

• Maintain audit-ready documentation standards

Team & Departmental Support

• Assist the Manager as required

• Maintain collaborative relationships with colleagues, service providers, and customers

• Promote a professional, efficient, and cooperative working environment

Key Interactions

Internal: Operations, Finance, Commercial

External: Customers, Agents, Carriers, Terminal Operators, Port Authorities

Core Competencies (Grade C – Professional Band)

• Integrity & Accountability - Ensures accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance in documentation activities

• Customer Focus – Provides reliable service and support to internal and external customers

• Continuous Learning – Understands documentation regulations and system updates

• Agility – Manages multiple shipments, deadlines, and last-minute changes effectively

• Collaboration & Communication – Works effectively with various stakeholders

Functional Competencies (Grade C – Professional Band)

• Regulatory Compliance – Knowledge of Brazilian customs requirements and manifest process

• Data Accuracy & Quality Control – Maintains high data integrity and timely document handling

• Customer Service Orientation – Maintains customer satisfaction through professional service

• ERP/Data System Proficiency – Uses digital systems for data entry and process control

Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Logistics, or related field

Experience:

• Minimum 2 years' experience in documentation, shipping, or port regulatory processing

• Familiarity with Siscomex, Mercante/Siscarga, and Brazilian RFB processes

• Proficiency in MS Office and shipping/ERP tools

• English – Fluent; Portuguese - Fluent

Work Environment & Specific Requirements

• Office-based role with potential port or terminal document runs

• Requires high accuracy, attention to detail, and deadline discipline

• May require extended working hours during vessel cut-offs or peak operational periods

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.

Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.

description:
Senior Tech Sourcer

Summary

We're looking for an experienced Tech Sourcer to join Kake's internal team and help build our sourcing function from the ground up. What You'll Do

  • Partner with recruiters during role kick-offs to align on hiring needs, must-haves, dealbreakers, and sourcing strategy.
  • Own end-to-end technical sourcing for new roles, building and maintaining strong candidate pipelines.
  • Design and execute sourcing strategies using Boolean search, headhunting, talent mapping, and targeted company research.
  • Create tailored outreach messages to attract and engage high-quality technical candidates.
  • Conduct initial profile and pre-screening assessments, identifying fit, gaps, and potential risks early in the process.
  • Manage sourced candidates in the ATS, ensuring accurate tracking, stage updates, and smooth handoff to recruiters.
  • Maintain consistent communication with candidates, supporting scheduling and follow-ups when needed.
  • Contribute to building sourcing processes, best practices, and documentation as the function scales.

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical sourcing or talent sourcing roles.
  • Strong experience sourcing for technical profiles across different stacks and seniority levels.
  • Proven ability to build pipelines from scratch using proactive sourcing techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, and ATS tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience helping to build or scale a sourcing function.
  • Familiarity with market mapping and talent intelligence.
  • Experience working closely with recruiters in high-growth environments.

Other Traits

  • Proactive and curious, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong stakeholder partnership skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement in sourcing strategies and processes.

Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it's not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world's most innovative companies, and we've built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We're proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we're the destination.The icing on the Kake:

title: Product Owner - Wholesale Banking
description:

title: Junior Support Analyst
description:
Junior Support Analyst

Reports To: Manager of Support

Department: Support

Location: Hybrid – Blumenau, Brazil

At MTech Systems, our company mission is to increase yield in protein production to help feed the growing world population without compromising animal welfare or damaging the planet. We aim to create software that delivers real-time data to the entire supply chain that allows producers to get better insight into what is happening on their farms and what they can do to responsibly improve production.

MTech Systems is a prominent provider of tools for managing performance in Live Animal Protein Production. For over 30 years, MTech Systems has provided cutting-edge enterprise data solutions for all aspects of the live poultry operations cycle. We provide our customers with solutions in Business Intelligence, Live Production Accounting, Production Planning, and Remote Data Management—all through an integrated system. Our applications can currently be found running businesses on six continents in over 50 countries. MTech has built an international reputation for equipping our customers with the power to utilize comprehensive data to maximize profitability.

With over 250 employees globally, MTech Systems currently has main offices in Mexico, United States, and Brazil, with additional resources in key markets around the world. MTech Systems USA's headquarters is based in Atlanta, Georgia and has approximately 90 team members in a casual, collaborative environment. Our work culture here is based on a commitment to helping our clients feed the world, resulting in a flexible and rewarding atmosphere. We are committed to maintaining a work culture that enhances collaboration, provides robust development tools, offers training programs, and allows for direct access to senior and executive management.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Technical Support to join the Support team. We are looking for a person who has strong technical proficiency, with good communication skills. Able to diagnose and resolve technical problems quickly and effectively, with empathy when interacting with customers. Collaborates with the team to continuously improve processes and customer service.

Responsibilities

  • Will contribute to building multifaceted enterprise and customized applications for a diverse and growing international client base. Tasks will include:
  • Provides support for level 1 and level 2 tickets about the use of the system
  • Develops and collaborates in the creation of materials to help clarify doubts (knowledge base)
  • Records the activities carried out in relation to support calls and derivatives.
  • Carrying out corrective and preventive maintenance on software, keeping clients up to date
  • Providing technical support to customers during the critical period of hypercare after Go Live
  • Identify and resolve technical issues promptly to ensure minimal problems on recent projects
  • Collaborate with development teams to resolve bugs and software issues impacting the post Go Live period
  • Communicate effectively with clients to keep them informed of progress and problem resolution.
  • Document and report issues for continuous improvement and future reference.

Education and Experience

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience).?
  • Years of experience: Some contact with support teams is desirable

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Experience with Experience in customer service and Support tickets tools
  • Knowledge of Windows e Office 365
  • English – Basic Level

Integrated into our shared values is MTech's commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. MTech aims to maintain a global inclusive workplace where every person is regarded fairly, appreciated for their uniqueness, advanced according to their accomplishments, and encouraged to fulfill their highest potential. Você quer trabalhar em uma Corretora de Valores com plano de carreira bem definido e personalizado, que dê a você todo o suporte necessário para alavancar sua carreira, com regras claras para seu bônus e uma trilha real de crescimento?

Na EQI Investimentos, você encontra uma Corretora focada no atendimento de clientes "Private", onde seu trabalho é valorizado: remuneração é competitiva, autonomia para negociar, plano de crescimento estruturado, liderança próxima, suporte integral, tecnologia e oportunidades para evoluir na carreira de "Wealth Management" ou empreender para ter seu escritório B2B. Aqui você tem oportunidades sob medida para umas verdadeiras evoluções na sua carreira.

Na EQI, sabemos que seus sonhos são únicos, reconhecemos suas conquistas e oferecemos estrutura real para você ir além.

Candidate-se agora e transforme seu futuro.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com investidores de alta renda em todo o Brasil;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com clientes através de visitas e contatos recorrentes;
  • Assessorar e acompanhar a carteira de investimentos do cliente com foco em seus objetivos;
  • Atuar estrategicamente em alocação de recursos e proteção de capital.

O que esperamos de você

  • Formação cursando ou completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificação CPA-20, CEA ou CFP — ou interesse em conquistar a CPA-20 (com suporte da EQI);
  • Experiência prévia no mercado financeiro;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, além de perfil colaborativo, com alta capacidade de influência e construção de relacionamentos;

O que oferecemos

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado.
  • Treinamento contínuo e capacitação para evolução técnica e comportamental.
  • Estrutura de Marketing e Eventos para apoio à prospecção de clientes.
  • Estrutura de SDR (Sales Development Representative) para qualificação de leads.
  • CRM Salesforce para gestão de funil de vendas.

Benefícios

  • VA/VR de R$ 1.812
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed
  • Vale Transporte
  • Auxílio Creche
  • ️ Gympass
  • Programa EQI VC+ (descontos com parceiros)

Etapas do processo seletivo

  • Cadastro
  • Conversa inicial com o time de recrutamento
  • Bate-papo com gestor
  • Proposta
  • Contratação

title: Data Architect (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 6 years of experience as a Data Engineer
  • Strong experience in Data Architecture
  • Hands-on experience with Cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, and/or GCP
  • Experience with Big Data tools and technologies, including Databricks
  • Solid experience with ETL processes and data integration via APIs
  • Experience across the full lifecycle: implementation, development, and maintenance
  • English level B2 or higher
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid, based in Portugal.

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL's headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, no46 em Lisboa or use the DPO's e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

title: Executivo de Vendas LATAM
description:
A Veja está buscando um(a) Executivo de Vendas Latam, para nossa área Comercial com atuação em São Paulo. Se você tem interesse por inovação e sustentabilidade, proatividade e gosta de colaborar junto a profissionais de áreas diversas para construir produtos incríveis, junte-se a nós!

Você irá:

  • Liderar a expansão regional em mercados latino-americanos, identificando oportunidades de entrada e crescimento.
  • Gerenciar key accounts estratégicos, desenvolvendo planos de negócios conjuntos e de longo prazo.
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais de alto nível, incluindo contratos, price tables e condições de fornecimento.
  • Definir e executar estratégias de go-to-market, adaptadas às especificidades de cada país.
  • Implementar segmentação de clientes por tier/canal, com portfólio adequado para cada parceiro.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com times internos (supply chain, jurídico, marketing e financeiro).
  • Monitorar KPIs de vendas, margem e rentabilidade, reportando resultados à liderança global.
  • Realizar benchmarks e análises de mercado, gerando insights para decisões estratégicas.
  • Representar a marca em eventos e ativações regionais.
  • 30% do tempo destinado ao atendimento externo de clientes/viagens.

Qualificações e requisitos:

  • Inglês e Espanhol Fluentes;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Superior Completo em Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de contas e expansão de negócios na América Latina.
  • Histórico comprovado em hunting e farming (abertura de novos clientes + crescimento de contas existentes).
  • Vivência em varejo, consumo e/ou lifestyle brands será diferencial.
  • Forte experiência em negociação executiva, gestão de contratos, definição de price tables e políticas comerciais.
  • Domínio de planejamento comercial, forecast e P&L.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde Nacional completo + Plano Odonto.
  • Alelo alimentação ou refeição.
  • Gympass.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Convênio Sesc.

Compromisso com a Parentalidade Consciente

Incentivamos e apoiamos a Parentalidade Consciente, promovendo o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Nossos benefícios se estendem para apoiar as famílias em diferentes fases:

  • Plano de Saúde Nacional – cobertura estendida para filhos(as) até completarem 12 anos.
  • Auxílio Educação filhos – apoio financeiro para a educação de filhos(as) até completarem 10 anos.
  • Licença-Maternidade de 6 meses.
  • Licença Paternidade de 3 meses.

title: Assistente fiscal
description:
Descrição da vaga

Ei, que bom te ver por aqui!

Você já conhece a ZAMP (Burger King / Popeyes / Starbucks / Subway)?

A ZAMP é mais do que uma operadora de restaurantes, nós somos uma comunidade que celebra a diversidade e a autenticidade. Nossas marcas globalmente reconhecidas são sinônimo de sabor e descoberta. Com mais de 1000 restaurantes espalhados pelo Brasil e uma equipe de 15 mil colaboradores, nosso sonho é ser a melhor operadora de marcas de restaurantes do mundo.

Inclusão é o nosso ingrediente secreto: Na ZAMP, valorizamos cada indivíduo e promovemos uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, portanto, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência e talentos de todas as esferas sociais.

Junte-se a nós nessa jornada, onde cada momento é uma celebração e cada desafio é uma oportunidade para transformar positivamente a vida das pessoas. Vamos juntos fazer o que é certo e construir um futuro onde todos têm lugar à mesa!

title: Sales Manager [Affiliates]
description:
We are looking for an Advertising Sales Manager to accelerate commercial growth with brands, agencies, and strategic partners. This role is responsible for identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and driving results through media, content, and digital advertising solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of clients, including advertisers and agencies.
  • Prospect and develop new business opportunities, leading the full sales cycle from first contact to deal closure.
  • Present advertising solutions, formats, case studies, and product offerings in a strategic and consultative manner.
  • Build strong, long-term client relationships by understanding business needs and developing tailored proposals.
  • Develop and deliver commercial presentations aligned with client objectives and brand strategy.
  • Negotiate contracts, pricing, and deliverables.
  • Monitor campaign performance to ensure excellent execution and client satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Marketing, Operations, Planning, and Data, to provide a best-in-class advertiser experience.
  • Maintain CRM and sales pipeline accuracy, preparing reports, forecasts, and key performance metrics.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in advertising, digital media sales, content, or tech.
  • Strong relationships with advertising agencies and/or direct clients.
  • Consultative and strategic mindset with strong business acumen.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong presentation skills, including experience with Keynote, PowerPoint, or Google Slides.
  • Highly organized, disciplined, and capable of managing multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with digital platforms, social media, adtech, or the creator economy.
  • Knowledge of digital metrics, media formats, and performance advertising.
  • Intermediate or advanced English.

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54563

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq!

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

O que você deve ter?

- Domínio em Java (8+) e ecossistema Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Cloud, Batch, MVC);

- Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID;

- Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluindo uso de serviços como ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3 ou CloudWatch;

- Vivência com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS) para integração entre sistemas e processamento assíncrono;

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis);

- Prática em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e versionamento com Git;

- Experiência com conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integração e performance);

- Desejável: conhecimento em NodeJS para integrações leves, APIs RESTful e documentação com Swagger/OpenAPI;

- Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) será um diferencial;

O que temos pra te oferecer?

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Gerente geral
description:
Gerente de Franquia de Soroterapia e Estética

Visão Geral do Cargo:

O Gerente de uma franquia é o profissional responsável por gerenciar a operação da unidade, garantindo a excelência no atendimento, o cumprimento de metas financeiras e a motivação da equipe. Ele atua como um elo entre a franqueadora e a unidade franqueada, assegurando que os padrões da marca sejam seguidos e que a empresa opere com eficiência e lucratividade.

Principais Funções e Responsabilidades:

Gestão Operacional e Administrativa:

• Supervisionar toda a operação da unidade, garantindo que os processos e protocolos da franquia sejam seguidos corretamente.

• Monitorar estoques, insumos e equipamentos, garantindo que tudo esteja adequado para os atendimentos.

• Acompanhar agendamentos e fluxo de atendimento, assegurando a melhor experiência para os clientes.

• Garantir que a clínica esteja sempre organizada, limpa e dentro dos padrões exigidos pela franqueadora.

Gestão Comercial e Financeira:

• Acompanhar o desempenho financeiro da unidade, analisando faturamento, custos e lucratividade.

• Definir e acompanhar metas de vendas para a equipe, garantindo o crescimento da unidade.

• Implementar estratégias de retenção e captação de clientes, incluindo campanhas promocionais e parcerias.

• Garantir que os clientes tenham um atendimento excepcional e retornem para novos serviços.

Gestão de Equipe:

• Coordenar recepcionistas, consultores de vendas e equipe técnica (médicos, nutricionistas, etc.).

• Treinar e motivar a equipe para atingimento de metas e excelência no atendimento.

• Acompanhar desempenho individual e coletivo, dando feedbacks e promovendo melhoria contínua.

• Resolver conflitos internos, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo.

Relacionamento com Clientes e Qualidade de Atendimento:

• Garantir experiência diferenciada para os clientes, acompanhando desde o agendamento até o pós-atendimento.

• Implementar estratégias para aumentar a fidelização e satisfação dos clientes.

• Monitorar reclamações e sugestões, buscando sempre a melhoria contínua dos serviços.

Remuneração, Premiação e Comissão

Remuneração:

• Salário R$ 4.000,00.

Vale-transporte e vale alimentação: R$ 1.000,00.

Horário: segunda à sexta-feira, de 09 às 19 h. Sábado 09 às 13h.

Bônus e Premiação:

• Bônus por Meta.

Perfil Ideal para o Cargo:

• Formação: Administração, Gestão Comercial, Estética ou áreas correlatas (não obrigatório, mas desejável).

• Experiência prévia: Mínimo de 1 a 3 anos em gestão de negócios, coordenação de equipe ou vendas em estética, saúde ou franquias.

• Habilidades: Liderança, comunicação, foco em resultados, gestão de pessoas e organização.

• Disponibilidade: Para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo sábados, dependendo da necessidade da unidade.

title: Engenharia de plataforma (Kafka) Sênior - CLOUD
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.

Estamos em busca de um profissional de Engenharia de Plataforma Sênior com sólida experiência em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. Este profissional será peça-chave na evolução da nossa infraestrutura de streaming em tempo real, atuando com protagonismo técnico e contribuindo diretamente para decisões estratégicas da plataforma.

Se você é apaixonado por construir soluções escaláveis e resilientes, domina sistemas de mensageria como Apache Kafka ou outros produtos e busca um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e com desafios de alto impacto, essa oportunidade é para você.

Nessa função você vai:

  • Atuar no desenho, construção e a evolução da plataforma de Data streaming em tempo real com Apache Kafka.
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de monitoramento e observabilidade dos clusters Kafka, utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch ou Datadog.
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção do control plane para gestão centralizada da plataforma.
  • Promover boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia junto às equipes de desenvolvimento, influenciando decisões técnicas e garantindo alinhamento com padrões corporativos.
  • Realizar tuning avançado de configurações do Kafka, visando performance e estabilidade em ambientes críticos.
  • Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos, propondo soluções estruturadas e sustentáveis.
  • Participar de escalas de plantão/sobreaviso e atuar em War Rooms, liderando a resolução de incidentes e contribuindo com planos de ação.

Pré Requisitos:

  • Vivencia em arquiteturas orientada a eventos e datastreaming.
  • Domínio de linguagens como Java e Python, além de experiência com containers e automações.
  • Vivência em ambientes AWS (SNS, SQS, Lambda, ECS, EC2) e infraestrutura como código com Terraform.
  • Forte conhecimento em sistemas Linux e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Capacidade analítica e autonomia para tomada de decisão técnica.
  • Habilidade de comunicação para atuar em times multidisciplinares e colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Diferencial:

  • Expertise em streaming de dados em tempo real com Apache Kafka.
  • Certificações em AWS ou Azure

Ao se tornar um ituber você tem

title: Account Executive - Marketing Solutions
description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil

SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise, reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity.

Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world's top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency, empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.

Visit our website: siila.com.br

About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it's an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We're looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA's products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform's advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients' needs and leveraging the platform's advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA's value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform's Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform's advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform's advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform's advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

· Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

· A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

· Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

· A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

· Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

· Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated.

· Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results.

· Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

· Coachable and adaptable, with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.

Follow us: @siila.br

title: Engenheiro de controle
description:
About Woodgrove

We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.

Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.

All resumes must be in english.

Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.g., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.
  • Verification and validation of software through inspection, simulation, and testing
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and implement control systems for new projects.
  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

title: Analista de Supply Chain Jr | Centro de Distribuição
description:
A Estrella Galicia

Somos uma empresa familiar, 100% independente desde 1906. Cultivamos o espírito artesano, mantendo vivos os valores inegociáveis e a paixão da Família Rivera. Nascemos na Galícia e chegamos até aqui sem perder as raízes, que se fortalecem há 5 gerações de cervejeiros. Somos artesanos e nossa arte é fazer cerveja a fogo lento, sem pressa.

Isso é Big Craft.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por 5 pilares:

Cuidado com as pessoas e nosso planeta: Valorizamos, desenvolvemos e reconhecemos nossas pessoas. Somos fortalecidos pela diversidade e respeitamos as pessoas do jeito que elas são.

Orientação para resultados: Somos engajados e comprometidos em atingir nossos resultados. Somos inconformados e obstinados na busca pela excelência. Conhecemos a nossa missão e pavimentamos nosso caminho com agilidade e proatividade, sem perder o foco.

Paixão pelo que somos e fazemos: Somos apaixonados pela nossa origem, história e cervejas. Superamos os desafios do dia-a-dia com entusiasmo e resiliência. Comemoramos e celebramos nossas conquistas e evolução.

Compromisso com nossos stakeholders: Geramos valor por meio de soluções inovadoras. Zelamos pelas nossas conexões, fortalecemos vínculos e desenvolvemos relações de benefício mútuo.

Integridade em nossas ações: Nossas decisões e condutas são orientadas pela ética, respeito e transparência. Atuamos de forma colaborativa e estamos aqui para fazer o que é correto, sem atalhos.

Em 2026, seguimos com todas as oportunidades como vagas intencionais para grupos minorizados.

Como será o seu dia a dia?

Você irá atuar no suporte administrativo e operacional do Centro de Distribuição, garantindo a conferência física e contábil dos produtos, a acuracidade de estoques, o correto processo de faturamento e a integridade das informações logísticas, contribuindo para a eficiência da operação e o cumprimento dos prazos.

O que esperamos de você?

Formação: Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia em Centro de Distribuição, logística ou operações de estoque;

Conhecimento básico de faturamento e documentação fiscal;

Excel intermediário;

Familiaridade com ERP (preferencialmente Datasul – Totvs);

Noções de CFOP, tipos de nota fiscal e fluxo de expedição;

Experiência com inventários e controle de estoque;

Vivência em operações logísticas de bens de consumo;

Conhecimento de indicadores de acuracidade e perdas.

Principais Responsabilidades

Conferência & Inventário

  • Realizar a conferência física e contábil de produtos no recebimento e na expedição, garantindo acuracidade;
  • Validar quantidades, lotes, códigos, avarias e documentação;
  • Executar inventários físicos, gerais e cíclicos;
  • Identificar e reportar divergências de estoque, apoiando ajustes conforme procedimento interno;

Faturamento & Documentação

  • Emitir e conferir notas fiscais de saída, conforme pedidos, rotas e clientes;
  • Validar CFOP (Código Fiscal de Operações e Prestações), volumes, pesos e informações fiscais básicas;
  • Apoiar o fluxo de expedição com liberação correta da documentação;
  • Organizar e arquivar documentos fiscais e operacionais, físicos e/ou digitais.

Rotina Administrativa do CD

  • Acompanhar entradas (inbound) e coletas (outbound) dos produtos.
  • Planejar as atividades diárias de carregamentos, distribuição e faturamento de produtos no CD.
  • Manter comunicação eficaz e integrar as equipes de operação do CD, clientes e parceiros, a fim de garantir o alinhamento de toda a cadeia.
  • Analisar processos operacionais para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, propondo e implementando ações para otimização de recursos.
  • Elaborar, monitorar e analisar indicadores de performance (KPIs) logísticos, como OTIF (On Time In Full) e acuracidade do inventário, entre outros.
  • Interface com áreas como Logística, Fiscal, Transporte e Comercial.
  • Seguir procedimentos internos e padrões de controle.

Qual será sua carga horária, modelo e local de trabalho?

  • Carga horária: 40 horas semanais
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial
  • Local: Nova Iguaçu/RJ

Wellhub/Gympass

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product's end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.

Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.

Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Sales Manager-Motion Control & Industrial Automation-Brazil
description:
We are looking for a Regional Sales Manager based in Brazil, responsible for expanding our automation business across Brazil and the entire South American region.

This includes building strong relationships with distributors, system integrators, OEMs, and industrial end users in key markets such as Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and others.

The ideal candidate understands LATAM's industrial automation market, has experience dealing with regional distributors, and can operate independently to scale our PLC, HMI, servo, and motion control business.

Responsibilities

1. Regional Business Development Across South America

  • Develop and manage business opportunities in Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and other South American markets.
  • Establish strong relationships with industrial customers in key sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (offshore platforms, drilling systems, pump control, skid automation)
  • Mining (conveyors, crushers, hoisting systems, process automation)
  • Food Processing & Packaging (filling lines, bottling lines, labeling & sealing machines)
  • Robotics & Automation (robot OEMs, integrators, palletizing/packaging robots, AMRs/AGVs)
  • Identify automation upgrade projects, machine builder opportunities, and OEM/ODM potential.

2. Distributor & System Integrator Network Expansion

  • Recruit and evaluate partners in Brazil and across LATAM with strong technical capability and service teams.
  • Assess integrators serving the above industries (mining automation integrators, food packaging integrators, oilfield service SIs, robotics integrators).
  • Provide training on products, applications, and industry-specific solutions.
  • Jointly drive business opportunities, technical proposals, and commercial negotiations.
  • 3. Sales Management & Project Execution
  • Lead opportunity development from first contact to contract signing.
  • Prepare technical proposals, quotations, and commercial offers tailored to industry requirements.
  • Track project progress (pilot runs, commissioning, FAT/SAT), coordinating with China-based engineering teams.
  • Oversee regional pricing strategy, inventory planning, and distributor sales performance.
  • 4. Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
  • Analyze competition in motion control and PLC/HMI markets (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Omron, Delta, WEG, Bosch Rexroth).
  • Understand industry-specific requirements:
  • Oil & Gas → explosion protection, extreme environment reliability
  • Mining → heavy-duty servo/VFD, dust & vibration resistance
  • Food Packaging → high-speed motion control, hygiene requirements
  • Robotics → EtherCAT, CANopen, servo performance, safety functions
  • Provide structured feedback to HQ regarding product localization, certifications (INMETRO), and market gaps.
  • 5. Marketing, Events & Branding
  • Represent the company at major industrial exhibitions in LATAM (FEIMEC, FIEE, EXPOMAFE, EXPOMIN, Colombiatex, Expoagro).
  • Organize seminars, workshops, and roadshows with distributors.
  • Deploy demo units for partners and key customers across industries.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related technical fields.
  • 5–10 years sales or business development experience in one or more of the following sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (onshore/offshore automation)
  • Mining & heavy industry automation
  • Food processing & packaging machinery
  • Robotics, motion control, and industrial automation
  • Strong understanding of LATAM's industrial automation ecosystem (OEMs, integrators, distributors).
  • Proven track record managing regional distributors and large industrial accounts.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people's lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.

We are looking for an Accountant Analyst to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. This role is ideal for a professional with strong accounting expertise, hands-on experience with local compliance, and the ability to work autonomously while collaborating with global stakeholders.

In this role, you will:

  • Prepare and manage the main financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow).
  • Lead monthly and annual closings, including P&L reporting, in collaboration with the CFO
  • Maintain accurate general ledger records, journal entries, and supporting documentation
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting, tax, and statutory requirements
  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable, including billing and reconciliations
  • Monitor cash flow and support foreign exchange operations
  • Support inventory control, monthly inventory audits, and reconciliation of assets and liabilities
  • Assist in budget preparation, financial forecasts, and variance analysis
  • Prepare financial reports for internal management and external stakeholders
  • Support internal and external audits
  • Contribute to process improvements related to accounting, importation, and financial controls

What we expect of you:

  • Good English skills (B1+, written and spoken)
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field
  • At least 3 years of experience in accounting roles (mid-level or senior)
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian accounting and tax legislation
  • Experience with ERP systems and advanced Excel
  • High attention to detail, organization, and ownership mindset
  • Ability to work independently and manage deadlines
  • Nice to Have: Active CRC; Knowledge of financial routines such as cash flow, AP/AR, and budgeting; Experience in multinational or international environments; Familiarity with IFRS

What we offer:

  • Salary: We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career: Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model: Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits: Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits: TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding: regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team: we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.

We will only contact selected candidates.
